frame: ALL 48 previously fixed public source archived Movebank GPS files remain in denominator: 24 original study files and 24 heldout study files. Exactly the 20 source-study IDs for which original calendar month×four-hour solar-clock radiation slopes are scientifically identifiable and already frozen are re-read for geometry sensitivity; the other 28 are still ledgered as UNIDENTIFIABLE, NEVER ZERO, with no file source substitutions.
provider_and_source_gates: Every selected original study must replay original GPS source provider bitstream UUID, exact provider checksum and bytes, native species/qualified original GPS step geometric statistics and original study sunward source group results. No GPS source replacement. Original weather ERA5 data are re-fetched from the same historical full-year grid; replay previous univariate radiation source context coefficient to <=1e-10 BEFORE computing geometry-controlled estimate. If previous model weather data have drifted so original source radiation cannot reproduce, mark SOURCE_WEATHER_REPLAY_HOLD and do not promote new result.
source_selection: Use the original unchanged registered closest-UTC-hour fix, original 0.5-2h actual observed GPS displacement >=0.1km <=60kmph and solar altitude >=10 deg start/mid/end. Keep exact original top two per original native taxon 1deg GPS grid×UTC year ranked solely on source original tagged animal counts and original step counts. Refuse if first source selected context's original GPS step count or animal roster support has changed. Only exact original source taxon×siteyear contexts with pre-existing identifiable shortwave response are eligible; no new positive effect or convenient new context allowed.
meteorological_model: Open-Meteo Historical ERA5 explicitly models=era5, UTC hourly wind_speed_100m,wind_direction_100m,shortwave_radiation,temperature_2m, 1deg source GPS midpoint cell center, original UTC hour floored. Record all provider raw response hashes and missingness (not actual GPS coordinates/weather URLs), no original weather JSON body snapshot. No new climatology API alternative.
biological_response: Original step sun-relative GPS travel-direction Y=cos(B-A), same original observed heading and actual astronomical solar azimuth at the true UTC/geographical midpoint. This is movement travel vector, not animal head-facing/sun gaze, direct sunshine exposure or light avoidance.
x_shortwave: ERA5 modeled same-hour surface shortwave radiation in W/m2. Main slope units per +100 W/m2.

geometry_controls.first: sin(geometric solar elevation at original GPS step midpoint)
geometry_controls.second: original apparent solar clock hour as continuous float, separately centered within each original individual calendar-month×four-hour apparent-solar-clock stratum
geometry_controls.note: The two geometry regressors are mathematically correlated. If rank/variance inadequate, HOLD; no retroactive control removal or ridge fitting. This controls altitude and remaining within-four-hour time movement but NOT season/route/habitat/wind confounds or all azimuthal geometry.

estimation.observation_blocks: Within original source tagged animal × month × floor(apparent solar hour/4), require >=8 GPS weather-matched moving intervals, >=3 original solar dates, original raw shortwave standard deviation >=60 W/m2 (population divisor).
estimation.source_animal_support: At least 2 eligible individual-time blocks AND 20 selected original GPS steps per animal; residualized source shortwave SD across eligible blocks >=30 W/m2, and retains >=10% of original shortwave variation after controlling geometric sun elevation and continuous local apparent solar clock; geometry 2×2 covariance standardized determinant >1e-8. Otherwise animal slope UNIDENTIFIABLE, not zero.
estimation.partial_slope: Within blocks demean original X shortwave, original response Y, controls sin(sun elevation) and within-block actual solar clock hour. Use exact closed-form Frisch-Waugh-Lovell pooled 2-regressor projection, without prior GPS route model re-fitting or regularization. Multiply Y/X coefficient by100 for one extra 100 W/m2 irradiance. Also recompute preceding frozen unadjusted univariate slope on EXACT original events as initial gate.
estimation.group: At least 5 original source-tagged animals with valid residualized shortwave slopes per original siteyear. 1000 original animal cluster bootstrap draws seed=20261025 for per-siteyear descriptions. Equal admitted siteyears within source taxa, equal taxa within original study ID, one original study ID contributes at most one original source average.
estimation.source_summary: All 48 source IDs retained including 28 support exclusions; at least 6 original source IDs with identifiable geometry-adjusted source mean needed before descriptive source-bootstrap of study means; fixed seed 20261025 with 2000 study-source draws, no familywise p-values.
estimation.planned_sign_interpretation: Compare prior unadjusted within-month×4h radiation slope and altitude/time-conditioned sensitivity on the same source GPS tracking years. Nonzero group association still not causal light vs wind; differing numeric slopes do NOT give a fraction mediated by solar geometry because individual/contexts admitted may differ.

scientific_question: Does the apparent irradiance dependence of animal solar-relative movement survive controlling for the exact astronomical solar elevation and residual finer solar time? This identifies residual weather-associated variation more sharply, not an adapted sun-compass or causal cloud/heat mechanism.
forbidden: Changing or suppressing old negative/sign-verdict source outcomes
Changing original source identification or selecting sources based on signs
Selecting favorable new solar azimuth/shortwave clock windows after results
Reporting site source coordinates, animal IDs, original GPS timestamps or source raw tracks
Treating source study UUIDs as independent world ecosystems
